_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil (score ±2 pts in only 3% of recent 12h windows) with offsetting bullish structure vs dead flows/liquidity keeps the rung pinned; no named breaker visible.
next_move.brains_agree: yes on current Anxiety phase and non-directional stance; narrative supplies no independent forward call
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds ~32-46 and 30d momentum stays near flat over next 12-24h with no ETF-flow or liquidity impulse
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear & Greed breaks under ~25 with momentum rolling down, or reclaims above ~50 with ETF flows turning up
